thread:
Kevin M: Quick sync — NovaEdge perf/W joint benchmark. Goal: measure perf/W and tokens/sec at target throughput (64k tokens/min) across our quantized runner. Need a kernel/kernel-module tuning window next week and a clear data collection plan. High-level asks:
- NovaEdge: driver + firmware + any recommended kernel cmdline
- Infra: exact images, kernel, and run command we should use
- Measurements: perf/W, p95 latency, tokens/sec, power sampling cadence
- Schedule: two full-day runs (cold/warm cache) + a kernel tuning pass

Elena (NovaEdge): Sounds good. We can provide 2x A260-equivalent boards, drivers v3.2.1, microcode v5. Firmware & driver tarball at: https://files.novaedge.example/drivers/v3.2.1.tar.gz
We can block Wed/Thu next week for tuning. We'll also include our nvx-kernel module with instrumentation hooks.

Samir Patel: Scope of metrics: perf/W (avg & tail), tokens/sec, p50/p95 latency, GPU power draw sampled at 10Hz, CPU-side overhead, and kernel-level counters (SM_UTIL, IPC). Also capture KV cache cold vs warm.

Anna K.: For infra we propose: image: redwood/infer:prod-2026-03, kernel: 5.19.12, cpufreq governor=performance, NVLINK enabled. Minimal run example we plan to use:
```bash
./run_benchmark \
  --model gpt-3-small-q4 \
  --seq-len 2048 \
  --batch 8 \
  --tokens 10000 \
  --power-sample 10 \
  --output s3://redwood-partnerships/novaedge/1765002468/artifacts/\
```
We'll also containerize the driver install step so runs are reproducible.

Cheng Wu: +1. Please ensure frequency scaling is disabled and P-states pinned during runs. NVML counters + perf counters to collect: GPU_CLK, MEM_CLK, SM_UTIL, IPC, DRAM_POWER. We'll want trace-level logs for kernel module during the tuning pass.

Elena (NovaEdge): We'll add a small kernel patchset (L2 prefetch + rx/tx batching tweaks) and nvx-kernel-rt v0.9 for the tuning pass — includes a measurement script that samples at 20Hz. Sending patch + runbook by EOD Friday.

Nova Partner Bot: lab-reservation confirmed for 2026-04-08 09:00-17:00 UTC :white_check_mark:

Kevin M: Great. Ownership: Anna run orchestration & artifacts, Samir owns metric validation & dashboards, Cheng owns kernel tuning coordinate, Elena/NovaEdge to deliver drivers + runbook.

Anna K.: I'll create the job matrix (cold/warm, q4/q8, kernel baseline/tuned) and share the matrix link here. Artifacts will land in s3://redwood-partnerships/novaedge/1765002468/ — will post signed URLs after the first run.

Samir Patel: Quick question — do we also want to include the quantized kernel path (int8) vs q4.2 path? My vote: include both, measure quality delta + perf/W tradeoffs.

Elena (NovaEdge): Yes — we'll provide q8 and q4 runtime builds and recommended launch flags. We'll also include a small reconcilation script to map counters to their metric names.

Kevin M: Perfect. Next steps: Elena sends driver+runbook by EOD Fri, Anna posts the job matrix by Mon EOD, team meets Mon to finalize run checklist. Thanks everyone :rocket:
